method: One rating per control per framework, judged only from the v1 control objective/activity text and the v1 mapped IDs. Full = the description covers the core intent of every mapped ID; Partial = it covers some mapped IDs or only part of their intent; None = it does not address the mapped IDs. N/A cells keep the v1 reason verbatim. Ratings were NOT tuned to reproduce the v1 overall status. Four cells (C002 NIST, C006/C012/C013 SOC 2) were re-rated against the corrected sample mappings in data/sample-corrections.json.
